playground.text: Usage alerts: get an email when a project reaches 80% and 100% of its monthly build minutes. Set the thresholds in Settings → Billing. Webhook deliveries now retry five times with exponential backoff before they are marked as failed. Failed deliveries can be replayed from the log for 30 days. Preview deployments get a comment on their pull request with the URL and the build time. Fixed: invoices for workspaces that changed plans in the middle of a month rounded the prorated amount down by one cent.
